sourceRecords.title: Japan First Commercial Floating Wind Farm Enters Operation
sourceRecords.sourceText: OffshoreWIND.biz reported that the Goto floating wind farm entered full operation on 5 January 2026. The source states that the 16.8 MW project uses eight Hitachi 2.1 MW turbines installed on hybrid SPAR-type floating foundations with steel upper sections and concrete lower sections.
sourceRecords.licenseNote: Public webpage; source text stored as concise factual evidence for manual archive prototype review.
